inputs.text: That is the finding of the entire assessment, in one sentence, from the accounts payable clerk. Thirty-nine controls assessed, eleven unreliable, five without a matrix rule. And the linchpin is none of these eight. It is the application administrator, who in no scenario takes anything himself, but who produces the evidence that ten other controls rest on. As long as that evidence is a manual spreadsheet, their reliability is an assumption and not a finding.
